g.title: j1304775402
g.text: We struck a deal, Drifter. And while it seems you did not need me to help you with Marie after all, just know that the devil always collects his due.

g.title: j2552262100
g.text: What an astonishing question. I have wondered that myself many times since my transformation into this Infested amalgam.

g.title: j2706269968
g.text: I will come for what is owed to me, whether or not you needed to use your end of the contract.

g.title: j2190673343
g.text: I couldn't get her to budge...

g.title: j3258767548
g.text: It's fine to leave things where they are. I don't need your help.

g.title: j4059208805
g.text: No, I feel like I failed him.

g.title: j3261848714
g.text: It's fine to leave things where they are. I don't need your help.

g.title: j3035100416
g.text: But I find myself thinking of her more frequently now that my memories are fully returned.

g.title: j4216311802
g.text: Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this.

g.title: j3232562987
g.text: I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.

g.title: j3903689393
g.text: Well, then I shall solve this problem for you and soon enough, I shall come for what is owed to me.

g.title: j2721263264
g.text: You might as well avail yourself of it. I will come for what is owed to me, whether or not you use your end of the contract.

g.title: j1896475573
g.text: Well, then I shall solve this problem for you and soon enough, I shall come for what is owed to me.

g.title: j28963877
g.text: You might as well avail yourself of it. I will come for what is owed to me, whether or not you use your end of the contract.

g.title: j565021317
g.text: You must understand how deeply complex and... harmful my relationship with that woman truly was. It is hard to describe precisely how much I adored her. And how much I despised her.

g.title: j3164988290
g.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?

g.title: j368728859
g.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.

g.title: j1302743033
g.text: I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.

g.title: j2306283727
g.text: Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this.

g.title: j2136554573
g.text: Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this.

g.title: j2849084449
g.text: I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.

g.title: j1792109719
g.text: More importantly, how much she made me despise every part of myself down to the very essence of myself. Yet without her, I would not exist. I would not be the man I am.

g.title: j3229452528
g.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.

g.title: j989676865
g.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.

g.title: j254687495
g.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?

g.title: j3328695345
g.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?

g.title: j2483599586
g.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.

g.title: j3360339046
g.text: She made me. She broke me.

g.title: j455765770
g.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly. So what say you? Do you want my help with Marie or not?

g.title: j2433067458
g.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly. So what say you? Do you want my help with Lyon or not?

g.title: j2821646677
g.text: I loved her. I wanted her dead.

g.title: j3192649211
g.text: The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you with debts to pay.

g.title: j3476556259
g.text: Yes, fine...

g.title: j3843456714
g.text: No. Leave it be.

g.title: j933081453
g.text: As you wish. Just remember, the only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you with debts to pay.

g.title: j460636754
g.text: Boolean RoatheLyonConfessionDeal is now false.

g.title: j1886148928
g.text: I hope this does not spur feelings of jealousy in you. That is not my intention. I am simply trying to provide an explanation of how much harm she caused me.

g.title: j2738869171->j1886148928

g.title: j271910200
g.text: Without her, I would not be what I am. I learned all that I know from her. She took raw clay and shaped it.

g.title: j1942168483
g.text: Yet how much I, in the same breath, owe her. Without her, I would not be what I am. I learned all that I know from her. She took raw clay and shaped it.

g.title: j2604463853
g.text: I understand. I've been in a similar relationship, once.

g.title: j246982796
g.text: It sounds like you really aren't quite over your feelings for her.

g.title: j2782727551
g.text: Do you think she's still alive? Or do you think she died?

g.title: j1075247982
g.text: Consider it done. Just remember, the only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you with debts to pay.

g.title: j1713655375
g.text: Consider it done. Just remember, the only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you with debts to pay.

g.title: j1845777769
g.text: I understand. It's okay.

g.title: j2151892296
g.text: I wish you wouldn't talk about her.

g.title: j1958300931

g.title: j1924796915
g.text: That isn't quite accurate. I am. I no longer love her. I no longer care if she suffers a brutal death at my hands. But I find myself overwhelmingly curious to know how her story ended.

g.title: j1206103728
g.text: It is hard to think that someone with such a taste for blood and death would be so quiet for all these centuries.

g.title: j2387099330
g.text: It is for the sake of the past that I find myself curious to know what became of her. Simply because I wish to know how her story ended. If it even has.

g.title: j2758913117
g.text: Pardon me, as you are the one who brought her up. You really are quite confounding, Drifter dear.

g.title: j3544138181
g.text: Then you can empathize as to why I am curious to know what became of her. Simply because I wish to know how her story ended. If it even has.

g.title: j1455952708
g.text: It is difficult to rid yourself of those who have been such a key player in your own tale. No matter how venomous they are.

g.title: j3138943665
g.text: If she is still alive, she has not been lying in wait of her own accord.

g.title: j1537602650
g.text: I will say this, however: If she is still alive?
